capabilities: Define activities and their permitted frequencies in settings
Mark activities as recommended or forbidden for the current day
Show today's allowed routines via a command palette command
extras: The README is written in a playful tone and includes one section in Chinese with an English translation.
motivation: The README suggests the point is having "a silly reason to not do unnecessary things" as a productivity hack.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pace recurring personal activities by allowing them only on certain days.
summary: Routine manager that applies the traditional Chinese calendar's Suitable/Unsuitable (宜/忌) system to permit activities only at set intervals.
